content.short: Mode is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless layer 2 blockchains within the Web3 ecosystem on Ethereum.
content.description: Mode is the Modular DeFi L2 building the Superchain alongside Optimism. By leveraging the underlying security and performance of the Ethereum network(s), Mode aims to deliver a robust and scalable solution for its users. The project offers a suite of decentralized tools tailored for layer 2 blockchains, ensuring transparent and trustless operations. As the Web3 landscape continues to evolve, Mode is positioning itself as a core infrastructure component to empower builders and end-users alike, bridging the gap between traditional architectures and decentralized networks.
content.meta: Mode is redefining layer 2 blockchains on Ethereum. Dive into detailed analytics and explore Mode directly on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
